description: An agent-based simulation model to study the spread of mask-wearing behavior through a social network, influenced by social interactions and government interventions.

behaviors.name: adopt_mask_wearing
behaviors.description: Agents decide to wear a mask based on risk perception, received information, and social influence.
behaviors.algorithm: If received_info or risk_perception > threshold or social_influence > factor, then adopt mask_wearing_status = true

behaviors.name: influence_others
behaviors.description: Agents influence others in their network to adopt mask-wearing.
behaviors.algorithm: Each day, influence others in network_connections with a probability proportional to influence_strength

interactions.name: influence_interaction
interactions.description: One person influences another to adopt or not adopt mask-wearing based on their social influence and connection strength.
interactions.effect: Increases the social influence of connected persons, making them more likely to adopt mask-wearing.

algorithms.mask_wearing_decision: Based on risk perception, information received, and social influence
algorithms.information_spread: Model information propagation through network connections

data_sources.name: train_data.csv
data_sources.purpose: Calibrate model using initial 30 days of data

files.name: main_simulation.py
files.description: Runs the main simulation loop and manages agent interactions

files.name: agent.py
files.description: Defines the Person agent class and its behaviors

files.name: network.py
files.description: Handles network creation and interaction logic

files.name: data_loader.py
files.description: Loads data from CSV and JSON files

files.name: evaluation.py
files.description: Calculates evaluation metrics for the simulation
